target: doctor.sh forge section — kind none with a remote warns naming the host and how to declare the forge
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://git.example.test/o/r.git
fx_doctor
fx_sec_has warn_host '\[WARN\].*git\.example\.test'
fx_sec_has mentions_declare '\[WARN\].*FORGE'
fx_sec_has fail '\[FAIL\]'
fx_done
